reuse.reason: The pinned official product-analytics plugin is Desktop-only, requires the Desktop authenticated analytics RPC and includes Session/Message identifiers. It has no website GA4 provider or exported public-page measurement component to mount or fork. This custom plugin observes native browser navigation without changing it and posts only a canonical registered public path to the independent Workers Measurement Protocol provider. No third-party SDK is loaded into the DSH document, so Enhanced Measurement cannot observe private Session titles, URLs or content. No official UI is replaced. The optional conversion-consent preference uses the unchanged official General item slot, Switch and settings field classes; the pin has no website conversion consent feature to mount or fork. Explicit grants live only in the mounted plugin memory, reset on refresh/unload, and are attached only to account/payment requests.
gaps: Public page views remain unlinked. Conversion consent is per tab and resets on refresh. No cookies, persistent visitors, third-party scripts or user-level attribution are added. Trusted backend events own conversions; browsers cannot submit a purchase.
